title: Localqw6 cehennem scripst
script:
-- GUI ve Butonlar
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
local ButtonCehennem = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ButtonEv = Instance.new("TextButton")

-- GUI Ayarları
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 250)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -125)

-- Cehennem Butonu
ButtonCehennem.Parent = MainFrame
ButtonCehennem.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ButtonCehennem.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -100)
ButtonCehennem.Text = "Cehennem Başlat"
ButtonCehennem.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

-- Ev Butonu
ButtonEv.Parent = MainFrame
ButtonEv.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ButtonEv.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, 50)
ButtonEv.Text = "Ev Yarat"
ButtonEv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)

-- Cehennem Etkinliği
ButtonCehennem.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    -- Cehennem mesajı
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Cehennem Başlatıldı",
        Text = "Cehennem ortamına hoş geldiniz!",
        Duration = 5
    })

    -- Cehennem efektleri ve ortam değişiklikleri
    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            -- Karakterin cehenneme çekilmesi
            local characterPosition = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            character:MoveTo(Vector3.new(math.random(-500, 500), 0, math.random(-500, 500)))  -- Herkesi cehenneme çek

            -- Cehennem ışık efektleri
            local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
            fire.Parent = character.HumanoidRootPart
            fire.Size = 50
            fire.Heat = 100

            -- Kırmızı gökyüzü efekti
            game.Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
            game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://123456789"  -- Kırmızı gökyüzü görseli

            -- Cehennem mesajı her oyuncuya
            game:GetService("StarterChat"):Chat(character, "Ömer Cehennem!", Enum.ChatColor.Red)

            -- Cehennem müzik çalması
            local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
            sound.Parent = character
            sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://451054248"  -- Cehennem müziği
            sound:Play()

            -- Yere blok düşürme (Cehennem havası)
            for i = 1, 10 do
                local block = Instance.new("Part")
                block.Parent = game.Workspace
                block.Size = Vector3.new(10, 10, 10)
                block.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-20, 20), 100, math.random(-20, 20))
                block.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                block.Anchored = true
                block.CanCollide = true

                -- Blok patlatma efekti
                local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
                explosion.Position = block.Position
                explosion.Parent = game.Workspace
            end
        end
    end

    -- Cehennem özel efektleri ve animasyonlar
    local function createHellFire()
        local fireEffect = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        fireEffect.Parent = workspace.Terrain
        fireEffect.Size = NumberSequence.new(10)
        fireEffect.Texture = "rbxassetid://123456789"  -- Ateş partikülü görseli
        fireEffect.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 5)
    end

    -- 100 farklı özellik ekleniyor
    for i = 1, 100 do
        -- Yeni efektler, animasyonlar, ve sesler
        createHellFire()
    end
end)

-- Ev Butonu Etkinliği
ButtonEv.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    -- Ev yapma
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local character = player.Character

    -- Ev ortamı oluşturma
    local house = Instance.new("Part")
    house.Parent = game.Workspace
    house.Size = Vector3.new(50, 20, 50)
    house.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
    house.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    house.Anchored = true

    -- Ev zemin efekti
    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Parent = house
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(50, 1, 50)
    floor.Position = Vector3.new(0, -10, 0)
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    floor.Anchored = true
end)
